title: Instrumentation and swing of the Bernie Young band
summary: A twelve-piece unit with three brass, three reeds and four rhythm, the same as Armstrong's 1931 band, which he says swung.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Well, did you write for Bernie Young's band?
Oh, yes. Yes, I wrote for Bernie Young's band.
Well, how big a band was that? I've
heard a lot about it, but not many details.

One, two, three -- three brass, three reeds, alto, alto, tenor -- that's right, three brass, three reeds, piano, bass, drums, and let me see -- did we have -- and guitar -- and banjo. Piano, bass drums and banjo.
-- and three and three. Twelve pieces maybe.
Yeah, oh, yeah, we really swung.
